source_note: 纯素读，仅读 text/chNN.txt，未开 md。字符区间为该文件 0 基字符偏移 [start, end)。

events.did: 早餐开场：Pavoni's 老据点；Gordon 三十六岁、新闻编辑肖像（秃退发际、打字机压弯的肩、深眼圈）；Quinn 自称 The investigative reporter。
events.quote_head: Gordon was already two cups of coffee deep
events.quote_anchor: Gordon was already two cups of coffee deep

events.did: 报馆危机：The Gazette 换报头换领导层、要标题不要深度调查；「没有抓人的故事我们就完了」。
events.quote_head: we don’t find one, we’re finished.
events.quote_anchor: we don’t find one, we’re finished.

events.did: 案件档案：码头死亡案——消失太快、无后续无嫌犯、尸体从未找到；官方结论：Cade Jensen，地产开发商，自杀，结案。
events.quote_head: Cade Jensen, real estate developer, suicide
events.quote_anchor: Cade Jensen, real estate developer, suicide

events.did: 干预假设：Gordon 不信自杀——「人不会半夜跳码头不留任何为什么」；「也许是有人确保没人去查」；语气不偏执，只是确定。
events.quote_head: Or maybe someone wanted to make sure no one looked.
events.quote_anchor: Or maybe someone wanted to make sure no one looked.

events.did: 太干净：标题 sensational——年轻开发商有钱成功不可撼动 until he wasn't；官方报告下来：自杀，无进一步调查，open-and-shut；人人都散了，「一个感觉太干净的结论」。
events.quote_head: A resolution that felt too clean.
events.quote_anchor: A resolution that felt too clean.

events.did: Eloise 副线：提到妻子 Eloise 时拇指绷紧、摆弄餐巾；「我们又在尝试了」（求子）；Quinn 知道现在不是多问的时候。
行业判词：Quinn 说每个故事无非权力/金钱/复仇三件事；Gordon 补：消失得太快的案子三样全占；「我认为有人确保没人追查」；Jensen 的名字点燃了 Gordon。
events.quote_head: And the ones that disappear too fast
events.quote_anchor: And the ones that disappear too fast

events.did: 章末：走出 Pavoni's 想放下案子（结了、不关我事），但「有人确保没人追查」粘在心里——也许他自己也想知道为什么。
events.quote_head: And maybe, just maybe, I wanted to know why.
events.quote_anchor: And maybe, just maybe, I wanted to know why.
